local_articles.title: SK hynix finishes filing for US depositary share offering
local_articles.snippet: SK hynix has finished filing its registration statement for listing American Depositary Shares (ADS) on the Nasdaq market Tuesday (local time), after adding its litigation risks into the statement. According to the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC), the company completed its ADS listing process by filing the statement with the SEC. The statement reflected a June 24 board decision to issue up to 17.79 million common shares, which is about 2.5 percent of its outstanding common shares, for the ADS listing. The statement left blank both the offering price, volume and the number of ADSs representing one common share, but the company said in its board decision that it seeks to have 10 ADSs represent one common share, meaning the Nasdaq listing could raise up to $29.4 billion if the ADSs are priced in line with the company's current share price. questions.title: Who will be appointed head of Syria’s National Security Bureau in July 2026?
questions.background: The National Security Bureau oversees Syria’s security agencies.
questions.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : An official Syrian government announcement or reporting by the Syrian state news agency SANA identifying the person appointed head of the National Security Bureau during July 2026. Resolution Date : The date the appointment is publicly announced. Accepted Answer Format : The appointee’s full name.
questions.current_reasoning: Syria's Ba'athist National Security Bureau was dissolved after Bashar al-Assad's fall, and President Ahmed al-Sharaa established a National Security Council in March 2025 alongside a restructured General Intelligence Service (initially led by Anas Khattab, who became Interior Minister in spring 2025, and since May 2025 by Hussein al-Salama). If Damascus establishes or revives a National Security Bureau in July 2026 to coordinate security agencies, sitting General Intelligence chief Hussein al-Salama and Interior Minister/former spy chief Anas Khattab (al-Sharaa's top security architect) are the leading internal candidates, followed by Defense Minister Murhaf Abu Qasra, Chief of General Staff Ali Noureddine al-Naasan, and senior presidential/interior insider Ali Keda. Given Damascus's history of elevating lesser-known former HTS security commanders whose full names emerge only upon SANA announcement, a full 50% tail mass is left outside these five figures.

local_articles.title: Syria's Sharaa appoints lawmakers, paving way for new parliament to convene
local_articles.snippet: July 1 - Syrian authorities announced the names of 70 lawmakers on Wednesday appointed to a transitional parliament by President Ahmed al-Sharaa, paving the way to convene the body next week more than eight months after the process of forming it began. The 210-member chamber, two-thirds of which was chosen by regional electoral colleges last year, will wield limited power under a presidential ruling system established under Sharaa since he ousted Bashar al-Assad in 2024. The People's Assembly will hold its first session on Monday, Mohamed Taha al-Ahmed, head of the Higher Judicial Committee for Parliamentary Elections, said during a news conference. The formation of the new parliament has been seen as a test of Sharaa's promises of political inclusivity in post-Assad Syria. questions.current_reasoning: June 28 Austrian Grand Prix race results reshape the Silverstone hierarchy one week out: George Russell converted his second consecutive pole into a calm, controlled victory (Mercedes' 7th win in 8 rounds) despite a broken drinks system in heat-hazard conditions, lifting him sharply (+0.05 to 0.27) ahead of his home British GP where he took pole in 2024. Kimi Antonelli finished P3 (+1.9s) after frenetic early laps from P4 on the grid and remains #1 favorite (trimmed slightly 0.36 -> 0.33 as Russell closed the intra-Mercedes gap). Crucially, Max Verstappen surged from P5 (after a Q3 crash) to finish P2 (+1.6s) with Red Bull's major Spielberg upgrades—saying it was the first race all year he felt he could fight for victory even with a late rear issue—catapulting the two-time Silverstone winner into #4 at 0.10 ahead of McLaren (still winless; Piastri P4, Norris P7, trimming defending Silverstone winner Norris 0.09 -> 0.06). Conversely, Ferrari's race pace and tyre life faded badly from P2/P3 on the grid to P5 (Hamilton, failed 3-stop) and P8 (Leclerc), trimming 9-time Silverstone winner Hamilton (0.17 -> 0.13) and pushing Leclerc (~0.045) just outside the top five alongside Piastri (~0.055), leaving 11% outside the top five.

local_articles.title: Nottingham Forest sack Vítor Pereira and turn to Oliver Glasner as replacement
local_articles.snippet: Nottingham Forest will make Oliver Glasner their fifth head coach in less than a year after sacking Vítor Pereira. Forest were offered the chance to appoint Glasner on a three-year contract after he left Crystal Palace at the end of the season and felt it too good an opportunity to turn down. The club had a break clause they could activate in June in Pereira’s contract, which they did late on Tuesday. Pereira, who led Forest to safety after replacing Sean Dyche in February, learned of his departure in an email received just before midnight. The Portuguese was surprised, having planned preseason in Portugal and held talks over transfers. Forest were close to appointing Glasner in December 2023 but elected to bring in Nuno Espírito Santo as Steve Cooper’s replacement.
